resume.execution: Actual owned indexHistory and projection on copied closed snapshots; owned metadata-only Git root exposes exact original ancestry/shallow bytes. No source analysis pending, and target applications/dependencies/hooks/compilers never execute.
resume.memoryMethod: 25 ms sampled all-thread descendant RSS over the complete probe lifetime, including raw payload/storage/geometry checks. No relative history performance gate claimed.

repositories.method: Independent JSON token hashing, raw complete SQLite payloads, original Git blob identities and SHA-256, integrity/membership/metadata/statistics checks; no target execution or UI projection

independentColumns.method: Independent Python sqlite3 streaming cursors and UTF-8 typed byte framing; every SQLite column in seven complete snapshot/version/membership tables
